content.text: The paragraph issue was a CSS specificity bug: VitePress’s generic article paragraph rule was overriding the intended `auto` side margins, leaving the 620px paragraph block pinned to the left even though its text was centered. I’ve strengthened the component-scoped rule; now I’m running the docs build and final layout checks before committing.
